pr_title: Set the status after the review

comments.comment: The change moved setStatus behind postReview, so a refused review leaves the head with no status, where the base set it first on purpose.
comments.failureScenario: GitHub refuses postReview with a 422 for a comment outside the diff. publish rejects before finish runs, publishStored prints "publish failed", and the head carries no status at all, so a branch rule that requires it waits on that head. The base set failure or success first, whatever happened to the review.
